peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (16.4): 1.4 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 65 of 405 similar developments with a figure (the same as 3). Initial resale-wave effect: 0 of the 1 resales in Oct 2024–Sep 2026 came in the first 12 months of the resale wave (Oct 2024–Dec 2024); the sustained rate is shown separately. The wave start is based on the analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date. Context, not scored: resales in 4.2% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: 1.6 resales per 100 homes a year over 21 months (Jan 2025–Sep 2026): higher than 76 of 388 similar developments. First resale wave from Jan 2024 (analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date). Observed 24-month activity: 1.4.

lines.statement: Holland Village MRT about 110 m, Buona Vista MRT about 700 m; closer than 528 of 551 similar developments (the same as 6). Straight-line distances.

lines.statement: 7 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 110 m), more than 275 of 551 similar developments (the same as 68); nearest hawker centre Holland Village Market And Food Centre about 200 m; nearest park Rail Corridor about 560 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 5 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Skye at Holland, 666 new sales, about 470 m; Blossoms by the Park, 11 new sales, about 1,000 m; The Hill @One-North, 14 new sales, about 1,030 m; Bloomsbury Residences, 123 new sales, about 1,730 m; Hudson Place Residences, 226 new sales, about 1,840 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 81 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,040 new sales and 371 resales (1,411 purchases); new sales were 73.7% of these purchases. Subsales (22) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 371 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 63 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 371 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 395 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−6.1%). Planning-area private resales −4.6%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
